screenshots.label: Checkpoint wrong-answer no-reveal at 390px
screenshots.text: Checkpoint1 of 2 questionsWhen an LLM answers a prompt by generating one token at a time, what is the model doing at each step?AIt reads with conscious understanding, then writes the whole answer at once.BIt changes its weights each time the user sends a new prompt.CIt searches a hidden database and copies the best matching passage.DIt scores next tokens from context, appends one, and repeats. Not quite. That gives the model too much mind. Fluent behavior can happen without awareness. Try another choice.
